top_signals.title: China Moves to Restrict Exports of Some Solar Technologies
top_signals.summary: China will restrict exports of several solar technologies, as Beijing seeks to maintain its technological edge in renewable energy while countries including the US and India ramp up domestic manufacturing.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Expanded dining options popular among soldiers, US Army officials say
top_signals.summary: “Chow halls operated on decades-old schedules that clashed with modern soldier work shifts,” one U.S. Army official said.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
